tools.name: harbor_get_order_draft
tools.description: Build an itemized, priced order draft from the current cart for a human to confirm before checkout. Returns each line with extended price, retail value, and margin; cart totals (subtotal, retail value, blended margin, deal savings); and an attention list (price changes, blocked items, substitution suggestions). Read-only. Tax, fees, and delivery are determined by Harbor at checkout and are not included here.

sessionKey.description: MCP client session key. Defaults to 'default'.

customerId.description: Harbor customer/store id. Defaults to active session customer.

tools.name: harbor_get_par_replenishment
tools.description: Suggest reorder-to-par quantities for a set of items. Source the items from an explicit list (itemNumbers), a shopping list (shoppingListId), or the current cart (fromCart:true). For each item with a par level on file, suggests the smallest order quantity that reaches par (honoring minimum order quantity and order multiples) with price and extended cost. Read-only — route accepted suggestions through harbor_add_multiple_to_cart.

sessionKey.description: MCP client session key. Defaults to 'default'.

customerId.description: Harbor customer/store id. Defaults to active session customer.

shoppingListId.description: Pull the item set from this shopping list.

fromCart.description: Pull the item set from the current cart.

tools.name: harbor_add_to_cart
tools.description: Add one item to the cart. unitOfMeasure accepts a code (EA/SP/CS/CT) or a word (each, pack, case, carton); quantity counts those units, so quantity:2 + unitOfMeasure:'case' means 2 cases. Validates the unit and quantity against the item's ordering rules and reports how many retail pieces were ordered. Requires HARBOR_ENABLE_LIVE_MUTATIONS=true and confirm:true.

sessionKey.description: MCP client session key. Defaults to 'default'.

customerId.description: Harbor customer/store id. Defaults to active session customer.

confirm.description: Required true for live mutations when enabled.

dryRun.description: Preview only. Runs all validation and returns the exact request that would be sent plus its projected impact, without changing anything and without requiring confirm/mutations-enabled.

quantity.description: Number of buying units (not retail pieces).

unitOfMeasure.description: Buying unit: code (EA/SP/CS/CT) or word (each, pack, case, carton). Defaults to the item's default unit.

includeTags.description: Include display tag on this cart line.

tools.name: harbor_add_multiple_to_cart
tools.description: Add multiple items to cart in a single call. Each item's unitOfMeasure accepts a code (EA/SP/CS/CT) or a word (each, pack, case, carton); quantity counts those units. Items with an invalid unit or quantity (below minimum or off the order multiple) are skipped, not silently coerced. Requires HARBOR_ENABLE_LIVE_MUTATIONS=true and confirm:true.

sessionKey.description: MCP client session key. Defaults to 'default'.

customerId.description: Harbor customer/store id. Defaults to active session customer.
